'''Letta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] who was allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
